notes.title: Metal Miners is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Thank you
Thank you to everyone who made this game possible. It has been a wild ride, and I am very proud of this game. I hope everyone who received this game enjoys it. Feel free to post in the forums if there are any issues. 

Leave a review on Steam
Please do this because it will help a lot with the way the marketing works! 

Anyway, enjoy! Thank you everyone once again.

notes.title: Metal Miners Release Incoming!
notes.content:
Metal Miners will release on November 18th, 2022!
Metal Miners was under heavy polishing the past few months. The games entire UI was remade with a brand new look. The original feel of the UI was kept, but the looks have been overhauled. There has also been a slew of QOL improvements.
[olist]
Tutorial System
Game Mode Selection
Balancing of resources
Many Bug fixes
New Map: Ziggies
Event Text shown in game
Some new sound effects
[/olist]

What's next for Metal Miners?
I plan on adding a couple more things to the game. First, I want to make sure the game in its current state is polished and balanced. If the game is polished and balanced, then I do plan on adding more maps and possibly some more abilities. 

Have a wonderful November! (If you're reading this on Halloween, enjoy the candy!)
